description: READ-ONLY - list the Q402 Yield lending markets the Agent Wallet can supply into. Returns each market's protocol, chain, asset, asset address, position token, market address, and current supply APY (shown as a %). No auth required and no funds move - this is purely a preview of available yield. Reads the curated lending markets on BNB Chain, plus Base when a curated vault is configured; each market reports its own protocol/venue. Deposit/withdraw (q402_yield_deposit / q402_yield_withdraw) cover both: 'bnb' (USDC/USDT) and 'base' (USDC only). Pass an optional `chain` to filter; omit it to see every supported chain. Use this whenever the user asks 'where can I earn yield?' or 'what's the lending APY on <asset>?' before supplying.

chain.description: Optional chain filter. Curated lending markets on 'bnb' and 'base'. Omit for all supported chains.

name: q402_yield_reserves
